notes.text: The heading אישתתא and body אשיתתא have different letter orders. The stored Davidson Eruvin 52a scalar has אישתתא, matching the heading; this supports the retained transliteration without harmonizing Hyman’s body spelling. Rav explicitly qualifies Yehudah alone, with no title transferred to Ishtata.
